# AWS Lake Formation

Store data lake settings, S3 registrations, permission grants and LF-tags without enforcing access or running queries.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `lakeformation` |
| Signing name | `lakeformation` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2017-03-31` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 19 of 69 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-lake-formation) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No query engine, permission enforcement, credential vending, cross-account sharing or IAM/S3 role and bucket existence checks.
- LF-tag policy/expression and data-cell filter permission selectors, registration federation and privileged access, ListResources filters and related-permissions queries are not implemented; unsupported members fail explicitly.
- Column wildcard LF-tag assignments are rejected; only columns with explicit assignments appear in column tag output, with inherited table/database values included unless ShowAssignedLFTags is true.
- Column names are validated for nonempty syntax, but not checked against the Glue column schema; deleting Glue resources does not cascade Lake Formation records.
- No native TagResource/UntagResource APIs or CloudFormation resources; resource tags in the Resource Groups Tagging API are not LF-tags.
- Settings and hybrid access flags are metadata only; no Lake Formation security policy, session filtering or AWS service-linked role is created.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
